policy: Path-only public projection. Original private bytes are archived locally by SHA256; original hashes are historical identity references, not hashes of projected public bytes. Review conclusions, proof-source hashes, executables/options and exit codes are retained; path arguments are mapped. Current public SOURCE_MANIFEST plus its canonical checked-build or optional fresh-replay receipt supplies the distinct portable build evidence. Lean proof bytes and root-relative Lean paths unchanged; manuscript namespace translation only in this binding.

identity_bindings.projection: Default target CurrentV43 only; all production-validated resource/library options retained.
